valuation.method: Loss-to-profit growth company: revenue x net margin = FY2028 diluted EPS (viewed at the Nov-2027 target date) x P/E. Per share of the SPCX listing in USD; ~13.9B diluted shares (13.58B outstanding per data feed; Q3 net income $4.4B / EPS $0.35 implies ~12.6B weighted diluted). Inputs from Q3 2026 results (revenue $14.6B, operating income $2.8B, net income $4.4B, Q1-27 revenue guide $33-37B, Q4 capex guide $35-40B); FY2028 revenue and margins are my own assumptions, not company guidance. Secondary-source figures were not verified against the 10-Q.

bear.driver: Revenue reaches only ~$200B in FY2028 as AI compute and Starlink growth slow; heavy depreciation from $35-40B/quarter capex compresses net margin to 12%
bear.assumption: Revenue $200B x 12% = $24B net income / 13.9B shares = EPS $1.75 at 35x

base.driver: Revenue ~$280B in FY2028 (below the ~$180B FY2027 consensus compounding at ~55%, far below management ARR ambitions), net margin 18% vs Q3 2026 30% reported / 19% operating
base.assumption: Revenue $280B x 18% = $50B net income / 13.9B shares = EPS $3.60 at 40x

bull.driver: Compute and Starlink ramps approach management targets: revenue $380B, net margin 22%

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $3.60 the $139.11 close implies 38.6x; the ~$250 published consensus target (Yahoo aggregate mean $255.63) implies about 71x at base EPS, or ~$6.25 EPS at 40x (about 74% above the model)
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.60 (2.6 pp of return); $0.50 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $20 (14 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Q4 2026 revenue versus Musk's ~70% sequential growth remark (~$24.8B, not guidance) and ~$22.6-23.8B consensus, plus Q1 2027 revenue tracking to the $33-37B guide and operating margin holding near 19% as depreciation rises
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4/FY2026 earnings release and 10-K, expected early 2027 (date not confirmed)

analyst_notes: Seven named analysts (all Buy-equivalent) raised or reaffirmed targets of $240-$500 around the Oct 20 Q3 report (Evercore on Oct 16), so every sampled target postdates or sits at earnings and none is stale; all horizons are undocumented so they are excluded from the weighted target. The gap to the base case is large: the sample sits near $300 versus a $144 base, equivalent to about 2x the model EPS at a constant 40x, or ~75x on base EPS; JPMorgan's $500 reportedly uses 20x a 2028 GAAP EPS of $24.41, almost 7x my FY2028 base. The sample is bullish and concentrated at the top versus Susquehanna Neutral ($173) and the published aggregate low of $70; Starship Flight 15 notes dated after Nov 13 (e.g. Citi, Bernstein, RBC) post-date the reference close and were excluded.
